newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPC surges ahead of interim results.
newsitem.headline: IPC surges ahead of interim results.

text.p: Shares in computer maker IPC Corp leapt 12 percent in early trade as investors punted in ahead of interim results expected later on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The rise is most likely because the results are due today," said one dealer with a local firm.
At 0200 GMT IPC stock stood at Singapore $0.505, up S$0.055 on volume of 3.8 million shares.
IPC has been a laggard performer which reported a loss of S$23.9 million in the 12 months to December 31.
"There's a lot of interest in electronics stocks so this could just be a rotational buy," another dealer said, discounting the possibility of a major turnaround in first half performance.
